data.one_liner: Production-grade background geolocation and tracking plugin for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides battery-conscious background location tracking, motion detection, geofencing, SQLite persistence, and HTTP synchronization for iOS and Android.
use_when: You need reliable background or continuous GPS location tracking.
You require geofencing with local SQLite persistence and automated HTTP sync.
avoid_when: You only need simple, foreground-only one-off location lookups.
You want a pure Dart implementation without native platform dependencies.
strengths: Extensive battery-saving features like motion-detection intelligence and adaptive sampling.
Robust offline capabilities with SQLite persistence and automated HTTP sync queues.
weaknesses: Requires complex native permission setups and platform-specific configurations.
Heavy package size and scope if only basic location retrieval is needed.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist, plus native handling for background capabilities.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a simpler, lightweight geolocation plugin without the advanced background telemetry and SQLite sync features.

alternatives.name: location
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a straightforward alternative for basic location tracking and permissions.
